answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. A new agent locks a 20-unit bond and builds a 14-day fingerprint from its cipher rhythm, timing, and partners. Release needs a trellis of three checks: fingerprint match, no shared device trail, and an umber mark for real work. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 20 = 2,000 units plus 1,400 faked days, sunk before reward. One honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
